correctness.rationale: Coverage iff ordered marker intervals cover every index; endpoint/gap criterion exact. rs>=k gives sharp fixed-r lower bound and explicit x_j=min(js-1,k-1) witness attains it. Balanced integer factors attain r+s=ceil(2sqrt(k)). A reversible bounded-slack bijection proves the exact counting polynomial and AM-GM equality yields square-case uniqueness. A literal subsequence verifier independently tests 227017 hosts and 52 fixed-marker profiles; these do not substitute for the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: All weight-one length-k binary targets form the simplest nontrivial composition layer of the subsequence spectrum; covering this stratum alone is a natural resource-constrained problem. The theorem determines every exact k,r optimum, global square-root savings, all fixed-r optimizer counts and perfect-square uniqueness for unbounded parameters. It supplies structural benchmarks not derivable merely from finite checking or full-spectrum coverage.
